scientific_delta_from_I0: Set teacher true-class BCE coefficient from 1 to 0; retain teacher-own same-GT TAL selection, detached quality weights, box/mask terms and denominator.

I1.teacher_candidate: teacher-own TAL same-GT anchor with max decoded box IoU; stable lowest-index tie
I1.qualification: teacher class argmax equals GT and teacher box IoU>.5
I1.student_mask_anchor: nearest GT center among student own TAL positives
I1.task_weight: teacher quality * sigmoid((teacher quality - detached student quality)/.05)
I1.denominator: all student-positive GT; no selected-set renormalization

training_recipe: exact train_transfer.py recipe used by I0_s42; AdamW/60epoch/b8/nbs32/640, same augmentations and data view
checkpoint_policy: last scheduled epoch; no best selection or silent resume
primary: Blueberry development full254 mask AP .50:.95 maxDet300
interpretation: If classification removal improves candidate/ranking behavior, this supports a component contribution but does not establish causality or paper-level benefit. If overall AP remains below native/strong D0, report the negative tradeoff; any new design must be separately frozen.
